post.yt_title: I'm a Good Person, Isn't That Enough? 🤔 #shorts
post.yt_desc:
"I'm a good person. Isn't that enough?" Fair question. When someone called Jesus good, He said: "Why do you call Me good? No one is good but One, that is, God." (Mark 10:18 NKJV)

Good compared to who? Next to God, all of us fall short (Romans 3:23). Jesus is the only one good enough, and He offers that as a gift (Romans 6:23, Ephesians 2:8–9).

📖 Read it yourself: Mark 10:17–27 (NKJV)

What question should we answer next? Tell us below 👇

post.notes:
- Mark 10:18 NKJV: Jesus' words quoted in full (verse opens "So Jesus said to him,"); the man had called Him "Good Teacher" (Mark 10:17).
- Jesus' reply points to God's standard of goodness; the video does not claim Jesus denied being good.
- 'All of us fall short' paraphrases Romans 3:23 (not in quote marks). 'Offers that as a gift': Romans 6:23; Ephesians 2:8–9; 2 Corinthians 5:21.
